Vitrification and Warming Media Analysis

Michael Whitehouse

2026-02-18

Oocyte Warming Survival Outcomes

  • thaw procedures in “OOCYTE THAW” attempts
  • must have corresponding cryo procedure in the EMR
  • summarize by cryo media, thaw media, oocyte age group

Blast Warming Survival Outcomes

  • thaw procedures in “EMBRYO TRANSFER” attempts
  • must have corresponding cryo procedure in the EMR
  • summarize by cryo media, thaw media, thaw protocol, day number, expansion grade, ICM grade, trophectoderm grade, biopsy count

Transfer Outcomes

  • same inclusion criteria as survival outcomes, plus those below
  • autologous euploid single embryo transfers (SETs)
  • exclude transfers too recent to have outcome data, as with KPI queries
    • include_in_bhcg_outcomes = TRUE for chemical pregnancy rate
    • include_in_sac_fh_outcomes = TRUE for clinical pregnancy rate
  • summarize by cryo media, thaw media, thaw protocol, day number, expansion grade, ICM grade, trophectoderm grade, biopsy count, oocyte age group, prior euploid transfer count

scripts_dir <- fs::path(project_dir, "scripts")

if (!exists("thaws")) {
  source(fs::path(scripts_dir, "process_raw_data.R"))
}

Data Overview

cat(summarize_cohort(oocyte_thaws, "vitrified-warmed oocytes", 
  'Autologous Oocyte Thaws', 'Includes only oocytes vitrified at M2 stage with cryo and thaw procedures documented in the KindEMR (i.e. excludes imported oocytes)'))

Autologous Oocyte Thaws

Includes only oocytes vitrified at M2 stage with cryo and thaw procedures documented in the KindEMR (i.e. excludes imported oocytes)

  • 3,878 vitrified-warmed oocytes
  • 298 cycles
  • 281 patients
  • 21 clinics
  • Date range: July 30, 2020 to January 29, 2026
cat(summarize_cohort(blast_thaws, "vitrified-warmed blastocysts", 
'Blastocyst Thaws for FET', 'Includes only blastocysts vitrified Day 5 to Day 7 with thaw procedures documented in the KindEMR'))

Blastocyst Thaws for FET

Includes only blastocysts vitrified Day 5 to Day 7 with thaw procedures documented in the KindEMR

  • 8,023 vitrified-warmed blastocysts
  • 7,721 cycles
  • 5,315 patients
  • 27 clinics
  • Date range: January 23, 2020 to February 03, 2026
cat(summarize_cohort(euploid_sets_chemical, "single euploid embryos transferred",
  'Single Euploid Embryo Transfers with Chemical Pregnancy Data', 'Includes only autologous single euploid embryo transfers with chemical pregnancy outcome data available in the KindEMR)'))

Single Euploid Embryo Transfers with Chemical Pregnancy Data

Includes only autologous single euploid embryo transfers with chemical pregnancy outcome data available in the KindEMR)

  • 5,325 single euploid embryos transferred
  • 5,325 cycles
  • 3,875 patients
  • 24 clinics
  • Date range: March 02, 2022 to February 03, 2026
cat(summarize_cohort(euploid_sets_clinical, "single euploid embryos transferred",
  'Single Euploid Embryo Transfers with Clinical Pregnancy Data', 'Includes only autologous single euploid embryo transfers with clinical pregnancy outcome data available in the KindEMR)'))

Single Euploid Embryo Transfers with Clinical Pregnancy Data

Includes only autologous single euploid embryo transfers with clinical pregnancy outcome data available in the KindEMR)

  • 5,178 single euploid embryos transferred
  • 5,178 cycles
  • 3,773 patients
  • 24 clinics
  • Date range: March 02, 2022 to January 13, 2026

Survival Rates

By Cryo Media

oocyte_survival_group_vars <- c(
  "cryo_media",
  "thaw_media",
  "cryo_thaw_media",
  "oocyte_age_group"
)

# render_survival_tables(oocyte_thaws, "Survival rate", oocyte_survival_group_vars)
oocyte_thaws |>
  select(thaw_survived, cryo_media, thaw_media, oocyte_age_group) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = cryo_media,
  ) |>
  add_p() |>
  add_overall() |>
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols(FALSE) ~ "**Cryo Media**")

Matched Cryo/Thaw Media

oocyte_thaws |>
  mutate(matched = if_else(cryo_media != 'Unknown' & cryo_media == thaw_media,
    'Matched', 'Not Matched')) |>
  filter(cryo_media != 'Unknown', thaw_media != 'Unknown') |>
  select(thaw_survived, cryo_media, matched, oocyte_age_group) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = matched,
    label = auto_label(c("thaw_survived", "cryo_media", "matched", "oocyte_age_group"))
  ) |>
  add_p() |>
  add_overall() |>
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols(FALSE) ~ "**Thaw Media and Cryo Media from Same Manufacturer**")

Logistic Regression for Survival Prediction

oocyte_thaw_model_data <- oocyte_thaws |>
  filter(cryo_media != "Unknown", thaw_media != "Unknown", oocyte_age_group != "Unknown") |>
  mutate(cryo_media = factor(cryo_media),
         thaw_media = factor(thaw_media),
         oocyte_age_group = factor(oocyte_age_group, levels = c("<35", "35-37", "38-40", "41-42", "43+")))

oocyte_thaws_logistic_model <- glm(
  thaw_survived ~ cryo_media + thaw_media + oocyte_age_group,
  data = oocyte_thaw_model_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
summary(oocyte_thaws_logistic_model)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = thaw_survived ~ cryo_media + thaw_media + oocyte_age_group, 
##     family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = oocyte_thaw_model_data)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                       Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept)            2.06967    0.18398  11.250  < 2e-16 ***
## cryo_mediaECMPC       -0.83425    0.19423  -4.295 1.75e-05 ***
## cryo_mediaKitazato    -0.16511    0.23540  -0.701  0.48305    
## thaw_mediaECMPC        0.05205    0.24928   0.209  0.83460    
## thaw_mediaKitazato    -0.24906    0.13732  -1.814  0.06971 .  
## oocyte_age_group35-37 -0.01559    0.14963  -0.104  0.91700    
## oocyte_age_group38-40  0.62560    0.21993   2.845  0.00445 ** 
## oocyte_age_group41-42 -0.04878    0.20381  -0.239  0.81085    
## oocyte_age_group43+    0.40169    0.39610   1.014  0.31052    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 1763.6  on 1845  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 1710.0  on 1837  degrees of freedom
## AIC: 1728
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 4
plot_forest(oocyte_thaws_logistic_model, "Adjusted odds ratios for oocyte thaw survival (95% CI)",
  caption = "Reference: Irvine Cryo Media, Irvine Thaw Media, Oocyte Age < 35",
  order_by_estimate = TRUE)

oocyte_thaws_gee_model <- geeglm(
  thaw_survived ~ cryo_media + thaw_media + oocyte_age_group,
  data = oocyte_thaw_model_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  id = patient_id,
  corstr = "independence"
)
summary(oocyte_thaws_gee_model)
## 
## Call:
## geeglm(formula = thaw_survived ~ cryo_media + thaw_media + oocyte_age_group, 
##     family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = oocyte_thaw_model_data,

plot_forest(oocyte_thaws_gee_model, "Adjusted odds ratios for oocyte thaw survival (95% CI)",
